what: Big-text cells (like four Chinese characters): 1 to 3 are picked at random, and each swells (or shrinks) to a random scale between .95 and 1.1 over .25s power2.inOut, then returns over the same duration. After resting .5 to 1s, it picks again. It starts when the top of the section first reaches 80% of the screen and keeps wiggling

options.max: Max number of cells picked at once, default 3
options.dur: Length of one side (sec), default .25 — same amount to come back
options.rest: Pause range before the next pick (sec) min-max, default .5-1
options.[data-fx-part=cell]: Cells that wriggle (children). If none, all direct children

from.where: index.html [data-jiggle] Chinese-character panel — original [data-split-jiggle]: pick random(1, min(3, n), 1) cells by shuffle, scale random(.95, 1.1) · .25s power2.inOut · yoyo repeat 1 · when done delayedCall random(.5, 1) · trigger top 80% once
